msg: Plugin stores user data but never registers a wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters filter. A GDPR Art. 15 export request cannot be answered from the WP admin. Add add_filter('wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters', ...) (WordPress 4.9.6 privacy tools API).

Plugin stores user data but never registers a wp_privacy_personal_data_erasers filter. Tools > Erase Personal Data will silently leave your rows behind on a GDPR Art. 17 request. Add add_filter('wp_privacy_personal_data_erasers', ...).
Plugin collects data but adds no suggested privacy policy text. Call wp_add_privacy_policy_content('Plugin Name', $text) on admin_init so the site owner's policy can name what you store.
Raw visitor IP is read without anonymisation. An IP address is personal data (CJEU Breyer, C-582/14). Wrap it: wp_privacy_anonymize_ip( $ip ).
Raw User-Agent string is read. Combined with an IP it is a device fingerprint under GDPR Art. 4(1); store a hash or drop it.

Google Fonts is loaded from Google's servers, which hands every visitor IP to a US provider. LG Munchen I, 3 O 17493/20 (20 Jan 2022) awarded EUR 100 damages for exactly this. Bundle the .woff2 files with the plugin instead.

Asset is enqueued from a third-party CDN, so the visitor's IP leaves the site before any consent. This is also a WordPress.org plugin review blocker (all scripts must be bundled). Enqueue a local copy.
Analytics or pixel code is injected from PHP with no consent gate. Under ePrivacy Art. 5(3) and TDDDG Sec. 25 this needs opt-in before the request fires. Gate it behind the site's consent signal.

Plugin calls an external endpoint with a hardcoded URL. Sending site or user data off-site without explicit opt-in is WordPress.org Detailed Plugin Guideline 7 (no phoning home) and a GDPR Art. 44 transfer. Ask first, and disclose the service in readme.txt.
A cookie is set with no consent check on the same line. Non-essential cookies need prior opt-in (ePrivacy Art. 5(3), TDDDG Sec. 25 in Germany). Wrap the call in your consent check.
A third-party embed is printed directly, which contacts the provider on page load. German courts treat this like Google Fonts; use a click-to-load placeholder.
Plugin creates storage but registers no uninstall cleanup, so personal data outlives the plugin. That breaks GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) storage limitation. Add register_uninstall_hook() or an uninstall.php.
